benchmarks.description: List of full glmark2-drm command invocations (one per line). Each string must be a valid command line as accepted by glmark2-drm(1), e.g., '-b shading:duration=5.0'. If empty, no benchmarks are configured (user should add at least one).

validate.description: If true, run a quick output validation test instead of benchmarks (--validate flag). Overrides any benchmark entries if true.

data_path.description: Path to glmark2 models, shaders and textures (--data-path).

frame_end.description: How to end a frame: 'default', 'none', 'swap', 'finish', or 'readpixels' (--frame-end).

reuse_context.description: Use a single context for all scenes (--reuse-context).

size.description: Output window size as 'WxH' (e.g., '800x600') or '-1x-1' for fullscreen (--size).

results_file.description: Output file for results, with extension determining format (.csv or .xml) (--results-file).

winsys_options.description: Colon-separated window system options in 'opt=value' pairs (--winsys-options).
